### [The Long-Term Benefit Trust](https://www.anthropic.com/news/the-long-term-benefit-trust)

**Anthropic** · 2026-11-05

Anthropic has detailed its Long-Term Benefit Trust (LTBT), an independent governance body designed to select and ultimately control a majority of the company's Board of Directors.

- The LTBT consists of an independent body of five financially disinterested trustees.
- Trustees have the authority to elect and remove Anthropic Board members, with their representation growing over time to a majority.
- The structure pairs with Anthropic's Public Benefit Corporation status to address non-market externalities and align governance with public interest over purely stockholder financial interests.

**Why it matters:** By granting board election and removal power to a non-financially interested trust, Anthropic shifts core corporate accountability away from exclusive stockholder control toward broader societal impacts.
